title: Only Business and Collective take money: a space_payments gate on every money path, personal selling off, tips open at 0%
detail: PHASE 3 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). space_payments at a Business floor in gates.ts, checked on paid tickets, paid memberships, donations, shop checkout and booking deposits, not waiting for the grace window. space_memberships, space_membership_tickets and space_storefront leave the free floor. Personal paid tickets and personal Market sales are refused. Tips stay open at 0%. A refusal returns the upgrade prompt (LIVE-758), never a dead end. free-seller.test.tsx and gate-meter-drift.test.ts are rewritten, not skipped.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const g=r("lib/pricing/gates.ts");if(!/space_payments:\s*\{[^}]*minEntitlement:\s*\x27business\x27/.test(g))fail("no space_payments gate at business");for(const k of ["space_memberships","space_membership_tickets","space_storefront"])if(new RegExp(k+":\\s*\\{[^}]*minEntitlement:\\s*\x27free\x27").test(g))fail(k+" still sits on the free floor");const s=r("lib/commerce/selling.ts");if(/ownerKind === \x27profile\x27/.test((s.split("export function canTakePayments")[1]||"").split("}")[0]))fail("a personal seller can still take payments");const miss=["lib/billing/tickets.ts","lib/billing/space-membership-checkout.ts","lib/billing/space-donation-checkout.ts","lib/commerce/checkout.ts","lib/spaces/booking.ts"].filter((f)=>!/space_payments|spaceCanTakePayments/.test(r(f)));if(miss.length)fail("money paths without the payments gate: "+miss.join(","));console.log("ok: every money path asks the payments gate")'
